name: Ooizumi Akino
source:
"Do get out of here. Now."

Minakami's landlady, the widow of the Ooizumi household. Threw Tamamori out for being too much of a fool. Tamamori fears her even now.

[From [url=http://lookiamnotcreative.tumblr.com/post/115559777068/koshotengai-no-hashihime-the-hashihime-of-the]Tumbleweeds Escapism[/url]]
